name: Canudos
startIntroPart1: The great Antônio — the messianic figure. Canudos was a small settlement that existed around 1890, bringing together Indigenous people, the destitute, freed enslaved people, and, above all, the inhabitants of the sertão. Yet our success drew the attention of powerful elites who devastated our settlement — but nothing will ever erase our struggle!
startIntroPart2: Antônio Conselheiro! Will you manage to create a great settlement that will last for years? Will you manage to help us overcome the challenge of time?
declaringWar: For the sake of faith and the honor of the poorest and weakest, you will be ordered to leave!
attacked: First of all, understand that you are attacking a poor and defenseless people, right?
denounced: Keep going, nobody wants to see how it ends.
defeated: Ah yes, it's done. You did it. Good luck.
introduction: Blessings to you and your people. I am Antônio Conselheiro, spiritual leader of this suffering people.
tradeRequest: I am certain that tomorrow's blessings will materialize by accepting this agreement.
uniques: City-State territory always counts as friendly territory
Non found more than one city
May buy items in puppet cities

name: Grão Pará
startIntroPart1: Eduardo Angelim! For a long time, the province of Grão-Pará suffered under the depredations of the arrogant and exploitative elites of the Brazilian Regency; this set the stage for the Cabanos revolt — or the 'Cabanagem' as it came to be known — which was the largest popular uprising in Brazilian history. Many betrayals and massacres took place during the revolt, but in the end, we were defeated and slaughtered by those who had sworn to ensure our safety.
startIntroPart2: We are weary of this suffering, Angelim! Please, give us the future we were promised! Will our independent province triumph over the test of time?
declaringWar: You are an imminent threat; I will not wait for your first attack.
attacked: Foolishly, we are only here because of our struggle. We won't surrender without fight.
denounced: Accepting this aggression is not an option.
defeated: Cowardice — you attacked the weak for your own gain. You are nothing more than a glorified tyrant!
introduction: Did you come here to join the fight or to fight against us?
tradeRequest: I'm restless thinking about it, but I want to see if you'll like it.
declaringFriendship: I don't think you're our sworn enemy, then; perhaps you could accept.
uniques: No Maintenance costs for improvements in [Fresh Water] tiles
[1] Movement point cost to embark <for [All] units>

name: Juliana
declaringWar: It's getting harder and harder to put up with you. I'll have to destroy you for the good of the Republic!
attacked: This will not be the end. We will resist!
denounced: You're confusing my respect with fear!
defeated: You defeated me, but you will be haunted by the tears of your victims!
introduction: Good morning, I am David Canabarro, General and leader of the Juliana Republic. We seek stability with our neighbors.
tradeRequest: It will certainly be mutually beneficial to both us.

name: Malês
declaringWar: I heard that some of my men are rebelling near your border, is that true?
attacked: If that's the case, we'll go to war; we will not be slaves again!
denounced: I will have to take drastic measures.
defeated: With this fate, I have only one wish: that God forgives you for your choices.
introduction: May God be with you, I am Pacífico Licutan. The Malês wish you peace.
tradeRequest: This needs to be possible. We'll make sure you don't regret it.
uniques: Cities are razed [2] times as fast
"Borrows" city names from other civilizations in the game

name: New Holland
declaringWar: You're not the same as knew, peace is not a option now.
denounced: We are not afraid, you are wasting time!
defeated: The Dutch East India Company isn't going to like this news
introduction: Welcome, You're in The New Netherlands. I'm Johan Maurits van Nassau-Siegen, the New Holland Governor.
tradeRequest: Come here, we are talking about you.

name: Palmares
startIntroPart1: Welcome to Angola Janga! During the colonial era, many enslaved Africans — alongside indigenous people and deserters — joined forces to defend themselves against the expansion of the feared Bandeirantes, thereby forming the 'Quilombo dos Palmares'. After numerous attacks, the great leader Ganga Zumba attempted to broker peace with the colonists — a move opposed by many within the quilombo — but he was mysteriously assassinated, reigniting the revolt and ultimately leading to the capture of Zumbi and the fall of the quilombo.
startIntroPart2: Zumbi! We no longer fear oppression. Shall we safeguard this small space for our people? Shall we triumph over the invaders?
declaringWar: I couldn't help but notice your audacity in turning against us. Quilombolas we will destroy the enemy!
attacked: These lands will never be yours. You will achieve nothing with this aggression!
denounced: I'm interested in what you're going to do after that.
defeated: Your resentment echoes in the destroyed ruins of the mocambos. You may have won this war in name, but I won it in spirit!
introduction: Welcome to the Quilombo dos Palmares, where enslaved people and deserters find refuge amidst the chaos. Tell me about yourself.
tradeRequest: I've been wondering if this is possible between our peoples.
uniques: Comment [Are posible enter in Foreign Land without open borders.]
Comment [Foreign cities located near cities border, receive a penalty in the cost of natural border growth.]

name: Piratini
declaringWar: You wasted my time with your disloyal agreements. I don't need nothing this! Let's make a true agreement, hahaha.
attacked: You disloyal fool, you don't wanna see what my army can do with your pathetic cities!
denounced: I don't need the opinion of a backstabber.
defeated: Maybe if I had more luck.
introduction: Greetings! We are so exciting to meeting you. I am Bento Gonçalves, the Great Major from Brazilian South Army or now Piratini Republic Amy.

name: The Tupi
declaringWar: We will not accept all your aggressions. The Tupi people will triumph over your fallen men!
attacked: Coward! You won't gain anything from this. Our people are not known for giving up!
defeated: Monster, I curse you, I curse your children, I curse your grandchildren!
introduction: The Tupi people welcome you. I am Cunhambebe, The Tamoios Chieftain tribe.
tradeRequest: Does this proposal align with your customs?
uniques: All healing effects doubled <for [Military] units> <in [Jungle] tiles>
[-25]% Culture cost of natural border growth [in all cities] <within [2] tiles of a [Jungle]>
